name: UF-vga-rpg-portrait
note: VGA RPG portrait (Eye of the Beholder / Ultima VII era). — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/vga-rpg-portrait.  (sample: seed 1049)

form.subject: an (elven sorceress:1.3), (silver hair:1.1), a (glowing amulet:1.2), pointed ears
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (full body:1.2), cropped head, (multiple faces:1.2)

sample_command: pixelmon 'an (elven sorceress:1.3), (silver hair:1.1), a (glowing amulet:1.2), pointed ears, dosart_vga, 256-color VGA pixel art, character portrait, role-playing game, 1990s DOS game' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora dosart-vga.safetensors --lora-strength 0.8 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (full body:1.2), cropped head, (multiple faces:1.2)' --out 128x128 --palette none --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1049
